create_VQDiffusionScheduler: create a VQDiffusionScheduler instance with a given number of vector classes and diffusion timesteps
run_step_VQDiffusionScheduler: run one reverse diffusion step using the VQDiffusionScheduler to predict the previous timestep sample
calculate_q_posterior: calculate the posterior log probabilities for predicted classes at timestep t minus 1
compute_alpha_schedules: compute cumulative and non-cumulative alpha schedules for a given number of diffusion timesteps
compute_gamma_schedules: compute cumulative and non-cumulative gamma schedules for a given number of diffusion timesteps
